patch_description: Make the annealing merit adaptive across the search horizon. Early iterations use a broad low-area tail, which rewards globally robust spacing and helps escape order types with many nearly-collinear triples. Late iterations use only the tightest constraints and substantially reduce the smoothing contribution, so acceptance increasingly follows the true maximin objective. The current state merit is recomputed at the current phase before each comparison, avoiding comparisons between scores defined with different tail widths.
